pages.text: Build the $(bold)Fission Reactor$() first: it starts the polonium road. Then build the $(bold)Fusion Reactor$(), the power capstone and the largest sustained RF source in the pack. This is the apex of the Engineering lane.

pages.title: Antimatter
pages.text: Fusion exists to feed the $(bold)Supercharged Particle Accelerator (SPS)$(), which turns polonium pellets and colossal amounts of RF into $(bold)Antimatter Pellets$(), the rarest engineering output. The SPS is the RF-hyperscaling sink the whole tree has been climbing toward.

pages.title: Spending It
pages.text: Antimatter is the hard reagent behind the pack's top-tier crafts: the $(bold)Mythic Catalyst$() line (combat endgame) and the $(bold)MekaSuit Mk2$() upgrade (tech-armor endgame).$(br2)$(note)The T4 questline tracks the antimatter sinks; see $(l:icraft:mods_t4/mekanism_advanced)Mekanism Advanced$(/l) for the apex-tech overview.$()$(br2)$(bold)Next: finish the SPS and mint your first Antimatter Pellet.$()
